articleTitle: Radiophotonics Module to Increase the Distance of the Remote Antenna
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Photonics (EExPolytech)
abstract: A scheme of radio-technical control systems for determining the coordinates of radio-frequency radiation sources using elements of radio photonics is considered. The use of fiber-optic analog microwave transmission lines with an external modulator and direct signal detection made it possible to increase the base between the receiving points and enlarge the accuracy of bearing detection. The influence of the operating modes of an external modulator on the transmission coefficient of microwave signals from antennas to a radio receiver module is studied.

articleTitle: Photostructures Based on Lead Selenide and Study of Their Local Current-Voltage Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Photonics (EExPolytech)
abstract: The work is aimed to the study of materials based on lead selenide PbSe obtained by chemical bath deposition from aqueous solutions. The layers are studied with atomic force microscopy (topography and local current-voltage characteristics) and Raman spectroscopy.

articleTitle: Trouble-free Operation of Ionic Dielectrics During Prolonged Exposure to Voltage
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Photonics (EExPolytech)
abstract: It is shown that, if the ionic dielectrics stay in the electric field for a long time, a substantial redistribution of the electric field strength over the dielectric thickness occurs due to the migration of weakly bound ions under the influence of the electric field. Usually, the most mobile types of ions are positive (e.g., sodium ions in glass), therefore, over time, a high-resistance region is formed near the anode, on which almost all the voltage applied to the dielectric drops. This provides strong electric fields and can lead to the breakdown. Quantitative estimates of the time course of this process are obtained. It was revealed that temperature is of decisive importance for the process under consideration. The result obtained seems to be interesting: for a dielectric such as alkaline glass, the time of its safe operation at a relatively low temperature (about 130°C) does not exceed several years. Obviously, this result should be taken into account when designing devices based on ionic dielectrics exposured to voltage.

articleTitle: Extinction Ratio Improvement of LiNbO3 Integrated Optical Interferometers by Photorefractive Tuning of Y-branches
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Photonics (EExPolytech)
abstract: The possibility to improve extinction ratio of an integrated optical Mach-Zehnder interferometer was investigated. A local LiNbO3 substrate modification by photorefractive effect was used for tuning the splitting ratio of Y-branches and balancing the power in the arms of interferometer.

articleTitle: Conductivity Switching Effect in Nanofiber Composites Modified with Conducting Polymer
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Photonics (EExPolytech)
abstract: Fibrous materials based on polyvinylidene fluoride and trifluoroethylene copolymers have been obtained by blend electrospinning and modified with polyconjugated polymer polypyrrole. The composite structure formed is a dielectric fiber in a conductive shell. The results indicate that by varying the degree of polypyrrole doping-up it is possible to change the character of the conductivity of the composite reversibly from inductive to capacitive.

articleTitle: Method and Device for Measuring Capacitance Type Electric Trancducers Parameters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Photonics (EExPolytech)
abstract: A non-destructive method for controlling the parameters of capsules of electrostatic transducers of a capacitor type with moving plates was developed. The method is based on the measurement of the capacitance-voltage characteristic of the capsule. Based on the results of this measurement, a whole complex of the most important parameters of the capsule is determined - the thickness of the air gap, the membrane tension, the surface potential of the electret, etc. As an example, the practical use of the method for determining the quality of electret microphones is demonstrated.

articleTitle: A Method for Increasing the Low-Temperature Stability of Steady-State Behavior and Common-Mode Interference Resistance CJFET Dual-Input-Stages
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Photonics (EExPolytech)
abstract: An original input differential stage circuit (DS) on complementary junction field-effect transistors (CJFET) is proposed. Their main designated area is low-noise analog ICs for operation at low temperatures, including cryogenic ones. The special circuit design for setting steady-state behavior of the DS and its parametric optimization in the LTspice environment provide a relatively high stability of the CJFet steady-state behavior of the input transistors in a wide temperature range. It is shown that, in this case, the common- mode rejection ratio is increased.

articleTitle: A Robust Uplink Transmission Scheme for Interactive Services in Future Broadcasting Systems
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Photonics (EExPolytech)
abstract: A dedicated return channel (DRC) for terrestrial broadcasting systems is considered to support interactive services. Compared with orthogonal multiple access based random access, non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) based random access technology is capable of supporting massive connectivity with higher reliability. In this paper, quasi-cyclic spatially coupled low-density parity-check (QC-SC-LDPC) coded interleave-division multiple access (IDMA) is proposed as a robust uplink physical layer solution for DRC in future terrestrial broadcasting systems. More specifically, QC-SC-LDPC codes, which have been recently proven to be universally capacity-achieving over different channels, are constructed for IDMA to exploit the inherent universality against the variations of spectral efficiencies, while the practical constraints of finite code length and number of decoding iterations are taken into account. Finally, simulations are carried out to verify the performance and robustness of the constructed QC-SC-LDPC coded IDMA scheme.

articleTitle: Electroforming and Resistive Switching in Aluminum Oxide Thin Films
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Photonics (EExPolytech)

articleTitle: Common Features of Algorithmic Approaches to Sub-word Parallelism and Torsion-free Abelian Group Decompositions
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Photonics (EExPolytech)
abstract: Sub-word parallelism is an effective technique for acceleration of media processing as well as some kinds of independent computations allowing parallelization. Abelian group decomposition algorithms realizing the sub-word parallelism technique are obtained. This method can be applied to distribution of boundaries within a word. The sub-words obtained in this way do not need to be of the same size in contrast with the other known optimization approaches. It makes the algorithms used quite flexible, universal and easily understandable since they can be graphically demonstrated. The main idea of such algorithms is taken from the theory of direct decompositions of torsion-free Abelian groups, which admit decompositions into indecomposable summands of different ranks.

articleTitle: Injection Currents in Si–С60–InGa Eutectic Sandwich Structures
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Photonics (EExPolytech)
abstract: The electrical conductivity of 300 nm thick polycrystalline С<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</inf> films on an n-type Si substrate was measured in the range of the electric field strength of 3•10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>-3•10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> V/m at 288-333 K. It has been established that the SCLC regime is implemented in fields above 3•10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> V/m. The total concentration of trap states has been estimated at 3•10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> at a trap depth of 0.35 eV.

articleTitle: The Detection of Charge-Dipole Centers in Composites Based on Polylactide by Attenuated Total Reflectance Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Photonics (EExPolytech)
abstract: The composites based on polylactide (PLA) were investigated by the method of attenuated total reflectance (ATR). The presence of the charge-dipole centers in the polymer matrix of PLA composites was confirmed. Their concentration decreases with the input of some low-molecular fillers, and, as a result, the stabilization mechanism of electret state was confirmed.

Author Keywords: the stability of the electret state

articleTitle: Decrease of the Frequency Shift of the Central Resonance of the Caesium-133 Quantum Frequency Standard
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical Engineering and Photonics (EExPolytech)
abstract: In the present work, several methods for decrease of the central resonance frequency shift of caesium- 133 quantum frequency standard are presented. The new implementation of the frequency synthesizer and magnetic field stabilization system for caesium atomic clock are developed. The results of experimental study of metrological characteristics for the caesium atomic clock with new frequency synthesizer and implemented magnetic field stabilization part showed improvement in daily frequency stability by 25%.
